q: A family's monthly budget is Rs 36,000. A pie chart shows 40% on food and 25% on rent. How much is spent on food and rent together?
What single discount is equivalent to two successive discounts of 10% and 20%?
exp: Net price factor = 0.9 x 0.8 = 0.72, so the single discount is 28%.

q: A 13 m ladder leans against a wall with its foot 5 m from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
How many prime numbers lie between 20 and 40?
exp: The primes are 23, 29, 31 and 37, so there are 4.

q: A's salary is 25% more than B's. By what percent is B's salary less than A's?
exp: Let B = 100, A = 125; B is 25 less than A, and 25/125 x 100 = 20%.

q: A can do a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. They work together for 3 days and then B leaves. How many more days will A alone take to finish the job?
exp: In 3 days they do 3 x (1/10 + 1/15) = 3/6 = 1/2; the remaining 1/2 takes A (1/2)/(1/10) = 5 days.

q: At what rate of simple interest per annum will a sum of money double itself in 8 years?
exp: SI = P, so P x R x 8 / 100 = P gives R = 12.5%.

q: How many square tiles of side 20 cm are needed to cover a floor 6 m long and 4 m wide?
exp: Floor area = 600 x 400 = 240000 cm²; tile area = 400 cm²; tiles = 600.

q: Which of the following is the factorisation of x² - x - 12?
Which activity best develops the concept of area in Class VI before the formula is introduced?
options: Telling learners to memorise length x breadth
Covering shapes with unit square tiles or counting squares on grid paper
Asking learners to copy formulas from the board
Giving a test on area formulas
exp: Counting unit squares builds meaning of area; formulas then emerge from patterns.

q: The population of a town is 20000 and grows 10% every year. What will it be after 2 years?
A trader buys 40 kg of rice at Rs 25/kg and 60 kg at Rs 30/kg, mixes them and sells the whole at Rs 32/kg. What is his total profit?
What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular octagon?
The product of two numbers is 2160 and their HCF is 12. What is their LCM?
exp: HCF x LCM = product, so LCM = 2160/12 = 180.

q: Five students scored 45, 60, 52, 48 and 70 marks. What is the mean score?
A man walking at 5 km/h reaches his office 12 minutes late; walking at 6 km/h he is 6 minutes early. What is the distance to the office?
In a group of 100 people, 60 speak Hindi, 45 speak English and 20 speak both. How many speak exactly one of the two languages?
exp: Only Hindi = 40, only English = 25; exactly one = 65.

q: A chord 16 cm long is drawn in a circle of radius 10 cm. What is its distance from the centre?
exp: Half-chord = 8; distance = √(10² - 8²) = 6 cm (perpendicular from centre bisects the chord).

q: If 2x + 3y = 12 and x - y = 1, what is the value of y?
exp: x = y + 1, so 2y + 2 + 3y = 12 gives y = 2 (and x = 3).

q: A Class VI student says 0.35 is greater than 0.4 because 35 is greater than 4. What misconception does this show?
options: Treating the decimal digits as a whole number without regard to place value
Being unable to read numbers aloud
exp: The student ignores place value after the decimal point; 0.35 = 35/100 < 40/100 = 0.4.

q: A student must score 40% to pass. He scored 180 marks and failed by 20 marks. What are the maximum marks?
exp: Pass marks = 180 + 20 = 200 = 40% of max, so max = 500.

q: What is the amount on Rs 12000 at 5% per annum compound interest for 2 years?
If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, what is A : B : C?
exp: Make B equal: A:B = 8:12 and B:C = 12:15, so A:B:C = 8:12:15.

q: The perimeter of a rectangle is 36 cm and its length is 10 cm. What is its area?
exp: l + b = 18 so b = 8; area = 10 x 8 = 80 cm².

q: What is the units digit of 3^15?
exp: Units digits of powers of 3 repeat 3, 9, 7, 1; 15 mod 4 = 3, so the digit is 7.

q: 12 men can complete a work in 20 days. How many days will 15 men take?
exp: Work = 12 x 20 = 240 man-days; 240/15 = 16 days.

q: A shopkeeper marks goods 40% above cost price and allows a discount of 10%. What is his profit percent?
exp: SP = 1.4 x 0.9 = 1.26 of CP, so profit = 26%.

q: What is the volume of a cone of base radius 6 cm and height 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
In an isosceles triangle the vertex angle is 40°. What is each base angle?
exp: Base angles are equal: (180° - 40°)/2 = 70°.

q: What is the average of the first 10 even natural numbers?
What percent of 2 hours is 15 minutes?
A boat goes 10 km/h in still water and the stream flows at 2 km/h. How long will it take to go 36 km downstream?
exp: Downstream speed = 12 km/h; time = 36/12 = 3 hours.

q: The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. What is its total surface area?
exp: Side = 7 cm; surface area = 6 x 49 = 294 cm².

q: What is the smallest number that must be added to 1000 to make it divisible by 7?
A school has 40 students in Class VI, 50 in VII, 60 in VIII and 50 in IX. What percent of all students are in Class VIII?
A sum amounts to Rs 11,500 in 3 years at 5% simple interest per annum. What is the principal?
If x + 1/x = 3, what is x² + 1/x²?
exp: Square both sides: x² + 2 + 1/x² = 9, so x² + 1/x² = 7.

q: Which of the following sets of sides forms a right-angled triangle?
exp: 8² + 15² = 64 + 225 = 289 = 17²; the other sets fail the Pythagoras relation.

q: What is the mean proportional between 4 and 25?
exp: Mean proportional = √(4 x 25) = 10.

q: Which of the following is an open-ended question suitable for Class VI?
options: How many different rectangles with whole-number sides have an area of 24 square units?
exp: An open-ended task has several valid answers/approaches and encourages exploration; the others have a single fixed answer.
